decisions.reason: The missing success modal is a runtime observation; the tipping interaction and disclosure change does not alter the modal's existing display condition or token-ID requirement.
The tipping transaction change does not alter fiat wallet creation, custody, holdings, or buyer access paths.
The source does not change the Transak provider, fiat conversion flow, supported payment methods, or deferred lifecycle.
The source does not identify USDC or change the connected-wallet approval-to-mint behavior; the separate follow-up transaction concerns only the optional tip.
The optional $1 tip is handled separately and does not change the fixed mint price or the required allocation of primary-sale revenue.
The new disclosure concerns the optional tip transaction and is already owned by the tipping Requirement; it does not change currency disclosure, payment selection, or card-option state.
The source does not identify ETH or alter ETH-funded mint execution.
The separate tip transaction does not alter exact-output ETH swapping, shortfall handling, or refund behavior.
The client requests a mint-page UI note, not an FAQ content change.
The tipping interaction and mint-page disclosure do not change any About-page content.
The absence of a commission after a no-referral mint is runtime evidence about no-referral allocation, not a change to the code-used referral commission requirement.
The immediate tip transaction and its mint-page disclosure do not change certificate delivery, contents, or ebook access actions.
